findings.finding: The cut FY26 guide still requires H2 net revenue of 614-654m against H2'25's 611.3m (i.e. +0.5% to +7% y/y) after H1 -5.6% and Q2 -2.9%, so the 9M print has to show Q3 revenue inflecting positive or the release steers to the low end / cuts a second time.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The first cut (31 Jul 2026, revenue 1,250-1,265 -> 1,200-1,240) drew only -2.43% on the day; the 19 May first guide plus weak Q1 drew -5.06%.
findings.why_not_priced: The arithmetic is not in any preview found and no broker note quoted the implied H2 growth; but the guide was labelled 'prudent' and net backlog coverage for FY26 was higher than a year earlier (300m vs 265m), so it is an inference the market may already discount at 4-5x EV/EBITDA.
findings.independence: Net backlog coverage for FY26 of EUR300m vs EUR265m a year earlier cuts the other way (same document); Equita called H1 'sotto le attese a tutti i livelli': https://www.teleborsa.it/News/2026/08/03/ferretti-equita-taglia-target-price-dopo-risultati-sotto-le-attese-e-guidance-rivista-a-ribasso-85.html

findings.finding: Q3 order intake faces a hard comparison: Q3'25 was EUR303.6m, +36% y/y on the Mediterranean boat-show season, while Middle East conversion was still delayed in 2026 (the Dubai boat show was postponed from April to 25-29 November).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Order intake is the line this stock trades: Q1'26 intake -33.6% coincided with -5.06%; H1 intake -26.9% with -2.43%.
findings.original_quote: Questa eccezionale raccolta di nuovi ordini, pari a circa €303.6 milioni nel terzo trimestre del 2025 (ca. +36% rispetto al Q3'24), grazie soprattutto alla stagione dei saloni nautici (this exceptional order intake of about EUR303.6m in Q3 2025, ca. +36% vs Q3'24, thanks above all to the boat-show season)
findings.why_not_priced: The comparison is public but no 9M preview quantifying it was found; the market is primed for weak intake already (two consecutive -27%/-34% prints), so only part of this is unpriced.
findings.independence: Dubai show postponement: https://yachtway.com/news/dubai-international-boat-show-rescheduled-to-november-2026 ; H1 release says MEA negotiations 'progressing with delays in final contracts signing' (https://www.emarketstorage.it/sites/default/files/comunicati/2026-07/20260731_187583.pdf)

findings.finding: The new CEO told staff in early August to come back in September 'ready for the best autumn in the history of this company', saying most 2027 orders are signed in the Sept-Dec show season; in June he said orders improved in Q2 'with large amounts' and intent would convert to orders in H2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance of this CEO's order commentary being tested by a print; his May and July prints both came in weak.
findings.original_quote: pronti per il miglior autunno nella storia di questa azienda ... La maggior parte dei nostri ordini 2027 sarà firmata in quei quattro mesi (ready for the best autumn in the company's history ... most of our 2027 orders will be signed in those four months)
findings.why_not_priced: Local-paper report of an internal letter, not in wire copy; but it is a motivational message, half of the four months fall in Q4, and the stock fell ~12% from its August high afterwards, so the market did not take it as a forecast.
findings.independence: Milano Finanza interview 13 Jun 2026: 'Nel secondo trimestre c'è stato un miglioramento degli ordini con importi anche elevati' https://www.milanofinanza.it/news/a-caccia-di-altri-yacht-2707564 ; H1 release: Americas Q2 intake +49.5% y/y

findings.finding: The bar is low: the stock sits at EUR2.65, -32% from the April EUR3.90 KKCG tender price and below every broker target found (JPM raised to 3.30 Neutral, Goldman cut to 3.50 Buy on 15 Oct; Equita 3.40 Hold), and the July guidance cut moved it only -2.4%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1'26 guidance cut -2.43%; FY25 prelims (24 Feb 2026) +0.52%; muted reactions to bad news since May.
findings.original_quote: JP Morgan ha alzato il prezzo obiettivo da 3,20 a 3,30 euro mantenendo la raccomandazione Neutral, mentre Goldman Sachs ha ridotto il target da 3,80 a 3,50 euro ribadendo il rating Buy (as reported; summary of the Teleborsa page)
findings.why_not_priced: It is by construction partly priced (it is the price); it matters only as asymmetry: a print merely in line with a held guide has more room up than down given -6.3% over 20 days into the print.

findings.finding: The closest listed peer, Sanlorenzo, reported H1 2026 order intake +18.3% with Americas +35.4% and confirmed its FY26 guidance on 3 Sep, so top-end demand was not collapsing industry-wide into the Q3 show season.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No measured read-through history from Sanlorenzo prints to Ferretti.
findings.why_not_priced: A peer proxy; Ferretti's own H1 intake fell 27% while Sanlorenzo's rose 18%, so the divergence may be share loss rather than a market signal; small and partly priced.

baseline_tension: The lean (+0.32, run-up only, no short anchor) and the -6.3% 20-day run-up point mildly up/mean-reverting; the guidance arithmetic and the order comparison cut against it, while the low bar agrees with it, so the net is a small negative with a wide, mostly direction-agnostic move.
language_note: The Italian eMarket STORAGE headers carried the exact release timestamps (09:50 and 11:27 CET) that settle the session as intraday; English wire copy did not.
Il Resto del Carlino (Forli local paper) carried the CEO's internal letter promising 'il miglior autunno nella storia' that no English source carried.
Teleborsa carried the 15 Oct JPM/Goldman target changes and the 13 Oct court-ruling filing; Milano Finanza the CEO's June statement on Q2 orders 'con importi anche elevati'.
lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide' (guidance changed: median 9.0% vs 2.3%): the guidance finding moved from -1.0 to -1.2 and abs_move_pct from 5.0 to 6.0, because a low-end steer or second cut is plausible and nothing of the period is pre-released.
'Size the move on what is new, let reaction history move p_up': did not cap abs_move at this name's muted 2-5% reactions; p_up left at 46.
'In a live bid, results are noise': checked; the KKCG partial offer closed in April and no offer period is open, so results are the event.
